+name: LUMO Kart – Modular 3D parts real engine acceptance
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [chatgpt/lumo-kart-modular-parts-20261114]
+    paths:
+      - scripts/games/kart_modular_route_props.gd
+      - scripts/games/kart_modular_aero_kit.gd
+      - scripts/games/kart_world.gd
+      - scripts/games/kart_vehicle.gd
+      - scripts/tests/kart_modular_parts_regression.gd
+      - .github/workflows/lumo-kart-modular-parts.yml
+  pull_request:
+    paths:
+      - scripts/games/kart_modular_route_props.gd
+      - scripts/games/kart_modular_aero_kit.gd
+      - scripts/games/kart_world.gd
+      - scripts/games/kart_vehicle.gd
+      - scripts/tests/kart_modular_parts_regression.gd
+      - .github/workflows/lumo-kart-modular-parts.yml
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  modular-kart-runtime:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 35
+    env:
+      LUMO_PROOF: ${{ github.workspace }}/modular-kart-evidence
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - name: Install pinned Godot 4.6.3
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot.zip" https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/4.6.3-stable/Godot_v4.6.3-stable_linux.x86_64.zip
+          printf '%s  %s\n' d0bc2113065e481c9c2c2b2c37daa4e8be3fe9e27f0ab9ab0b6096e9a37907f3 "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot.zip" | sha256sum -c -
+          unzip -q "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot.zip" -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot-bin"
+          ln -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot-bin/Godot_v4.6.3-stable_linux.x86_64" "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot-bin/godot"
+          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot-bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
+      - name: Import full original project; reject any parse errors
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          mkdir -p "$LUMO_PROOF"
+          git rev-parse HEAD > "$LUMO_PROOF/source-sha.txt"
+          godot --version | tee "$LUMO_PROOF/engine.txt"
+          python3 tools/validate_project.py 2>&1 | tee "$LUMO_PROOF/source-validation.log"
+          godot --headless --editor --import --path . 2>&1 | tee "$LUMO_PROOF/real-import.log"
+          if grep -qE 'SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error|ERROR:' "$LUMO_PROOF/real-import.log"; then
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          git diff --exit-code HEAD --
+      - name: Verify new pieces in the actual runtime worlds and four real chassis
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          python3 tools/run_godot_probe.py --log "$LUMO_PROOF/runtime.log" --timeout 900 \
+            --required '[KartModularParts] PASS' -- \
+            godot --headless --audio-driver Dummy --path . \
+            --script res://scripts/tests/kart_modular_parts_regression.gd
+      - name: Record complete source-bound diagnostics
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: lumo-kart-modular-parts-real-engine
+          path: modular-kart-evidence/
+          retention-days: 30
+          if-no-files-found: warn

+# LUMO Kart — Modular 3D Track Parts & Chassis Aero Kit (14 November 2026)
+
+## Current result and scope
+Real source-connected geometry, added on `chatgpt/lumo-kart-modular-parts-20261114` from the already tested `chatgpt/lumo-kart-adventure-20261114-a839` branch. No external Nintendo geometry, no new paid dependencies, no change to the original characters, rigs, race rewards, route coordinates, saves or vehicle collision model.
+
+### New, actually wired parts
+- **Four reusable roadside families:** floating wayfinding beacons (crystal/torus), illuminated service platforms with real panels and raised control lamps, open-road high-clearance signal gantries with star-shaped markers, and gyroscopic track sculptures.
+- **Theme-specific palettes** from each of the twelve course definitions, augmented with the selected course's own dark support material.
+- **14 existing fleet chassis** use the shared aero-kit hook in `kart_vehicle.gd` before static batching and LOD generation; the four representative bodies (Comet, Glider, Terra, Phantom) are checked by the new regression.
+- **Kart manufactured finishes**: pairwise aerodynamic sill assemblies and LED accents; inset nose intakes with individually moulded vanes; machined exhaust bezels and energy rings; raised nose chevrons; an integrated rear bumper cap.
+- No new collision or gameplay triggers. The loop, ramps, jumps, action pads, rival AI and item scoring remain authoritative.
+
+### Production integration
+`kart_world.gd` calls `kart_modular_route_props.gd` in **all three** world-build branches (Himmelsinseln, expansion tracks, original world). The parts are submitted to the existing 48 m-cell `_prop` and `_flush_instances` GPU MultiMesh batches. Mobile builds use eight candidate sites per course and fewer decorative details; high-detail builds use thirteen. Actual placement skips the protected tunnel corridor, bridge-like action zones, jumps, open edges and nearby return roads.
+
+`kart_vehicle.gd` calls `kart_modular_aero_kit.gd` immediately after the established coachwork pass. Near-only microdetails have disabled shadow casting and retain the existing LOD/far proxy mechanism.
+
+### Quality gates
+`scripts/tests/kart_modular_parts_regression.gd` is source-bound to the genuine production classes and checks:
+- 12 mobile tracks + 2 full-detail tracks; planned physical site clearance and batched runtime geometry;
+- Original safety rail, no added scenery colliders, no track/physics edits;
+- 14 catalog styles retained; four representative live chassis with their four wheel pivots and bounded aero components.
+
+CI workflow `.github/workflows/lumo-kart-modular-parts.yml` runs actual Godot 4.6.3 import and regression. Evidence is tied to the exact branch commit. On this chat's execution host, Godot/Blender executables are unavailable, so no local engine render or Fold7 frame time is asserted before the CI or device results arrive.
+
+### How to run
+```bash
+godot --headless --editor --import --path .
+godot --headless --path . --script res://scripts/tests/kart_modular_parts_regression.gd
+```
+
+This is a development branch, not a merged Android APK. Godot source assets can be included in the existing LUMO Flutter/Godot release pipeline after green regression and real Android Fold7 checks.

+extends RefCounted
+## Additional physically modeled aero / lighting hardware for the production fleet.
+## No changes to collider dimensions, chassis anchors, steering joints or original rigs.
+## Called before the existing static combine and distance LOD generation.
+
+const CRAFT = preload("res://scripts/games/kart_coachwork_finish.gd")
+const STEEL := Color("67788b")
+const DARK := Color("192632")
+const RUBBER := Color("101921")
+
+
+static func _detail(kart, node: MeshInstance3D, name: String, close_only: bool = false) -> void:
+	# All optional parts use the existing machined coachwork finish family.
+	# Vertex-colour batching preserves their unique pigment without extra draw passes.
+	var source: StandardMaterial3D = node.material_override as StandardMaterial3D
+	assert(source != null)
+	node.material_override = kart._mat(source.albedo_color, 0.35, 0.56)
+	node.name = name
+	if close_only:
+		node.set_meta("near_only", true)
+		node.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+
+
+static func decorate(kart, body: Node3D, spec: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var accent: Color = spec.get("accent", Color("6ddfff"))
+	var paint: Color = spec.get("paint", Color("4778a5"))
+	var pieces: int = 0
+	# Sculpted side skirt and inset LED trim; each is inside the existing wheel width.
+	for side in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+		var sill: MeshInstance3D = CRAFT.rounded_box(kart, body,
+			Vector3(side * 0.545, 0.344, 0.01), Vector3(0.11, 0.115, 0.60),
+			DARK, 0.35, 0.56)
+		_detail(kart, sill, "AeroSideSkirt")
+		pieces += 1
+		var edge: MeshInstance3D = CRAFT.rounded_box(kart, body,
+			Vector3(side * 0.612, 0.394, 0.01), Vector3(0.018, 0.030, 0.52),
+			accent, 0.35, 0.26)
+		_detail(kart, edge, "AeroSillLight", true)
+		pieces += 1
+		# A real bevelled aero intake with a dark interior and four pressed vanes.
+		var surround: MeshInstance3D = CRAFT.rounded_box(kart, body,
+			Vector3(side * 0.45, 0.492, -0.79), Vector3(0.16, 0.125, 0.185),
+			paint.darkened(0.17), 0.35, 0.26)
+		_detail(kart, surround, "SculptedNoseIntake")
+		pieces += 1
+		var well: MeshInstance3D = CRAFT.rounded_box(kart, body,
+			Vector3(side * 0.454, 0.514, -0.793), Vector3(0.108, 0.022, 0.134),
+			RUBBER, 0.0, 0.82)
+		_detail(kart, well, "NoseIntakeWell")
+		pieces += 1
+		for fin in range(3):
+			var at: Vector3 = Vector3(side * 0.456, 0.53, -0.842 + fin * 0.049)
+			var vane: MeshInstance3D = CRAFT.rounded_box(kart, body,
+				at, Vector3(0.08, 0.013, 0.014), STEEL, 0.7, 0.26)
+			_detail(kart, vane, "NoseIntakeVane", true)
+			pieces += 1
+		# Twin metallic exhaust bezels, properly oriented toward the rear.
+		var nozzle: MeshInstance3D = kart._ring(body,
+			Vector3(side * 0.34, 0.466, 1.162), 0.079, 0.112, STEEL, 0.7)
+		nozzle.rotation.x = PI * 0.5
+		_detail(kart, nozzle, "ExhaustMachinedBezel", true)
+		pieces += 1
+		var core: MeshInstance3D = kart._ring(body,
+			Vector3(side * 0.34, 0.466, 1.174), 0.046, 0.067, accent, 0.35)
+		core.rotation.x = PI * 0.5
+		_detail(kart, core, "ExhaustEnergyRing", true)
+		pieces += 1
+	# Centerline insignia and low-profile chevrons never enter the driver's footwell.
+	var badge: MeshInstance3D = CRAFT.rounded_box(kart, body,
+		Vector3(0.0, 0.575, -0.955), Vector3(0.20, 0.035, 0.15),
+		STEEL, 0.70, 0.26)
+	_detail(kart, badge, "AuroraNoseEmblemSeat")
+	pieces += 1
+	for side in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+		var stripe: MeshInstance3D = CRAFT.rounded_box(kart, body,
+			Vector3(side * 0.085, 0.600, -0.952),
+			Vector3(0.035, 0.010, 0.105), accent, 0.35, 0.26)
+		stripe.rotation.y = side * 0.32
+		_detail(kart, stripe, "AuroraRaisedChevron", true)
+		pieces += 1
+	# The physical rear diffuser remains owned by the vehicle; small overlay only.
+	var rear: MeshInstance3D = CRAFT.rounded_box(kart, body,
+		Vector3(0.0, 0.363, 1.139), Vector3(0.49, 0.040, 0.075),
+		DARK, 0.35, 0.56)
+	_detail(kart, rear, "RearBumperAeroCap")
+	pieces += 1

+extends RefCounted
+## Physically modelled, reusable LUMO Kart roadside parts.
+## Decoration only: no CollisionObject3D, Item award, modified road or checkpoints.
+## All primitives are fed into the production world's spatial MultiMesh batching.
+
+const TUNNELS = preload("res://scripts/games/kart_adventure_tunnels.gd")
+const SAFETY_LATERAL_M: float = 8.25
+const GANTRY_TOP_M: float = 8.5
+const MIN_GAP_M: float = 25.0
+const LOW_CANDIDATES: int = 8
+const HIGH_CANDIDATES: int = 13
+
+static func candidate_distances(length_m: float, low_detail: bool) -> PackedFloat32Array:
+	var result := PackedFloat32Array()
+	var count: int = LOW_CANDIDATES if low_detail else HIGH_CANDIDATES
+	for index in range(count):
+		result.append(length_m * (0.055 + (float(index) + 0.5) * 0.89 / float(count)))
+	return result
+
+
+static func _overlaps(distance: float, start: float, finish: float, padding: float) -> bool:
+	return distance >= start - padding and distance <= finish + padding
+
+
+static func is_safe_site(world, distance: float) -> bool:
+	if distance < 32.0 or distance > world.length - 32.0:
+		return false
+	if TUNNELS.contains(world, distance, MIN_GAP_M):
+		return false
+	if not world.loop_layout.is_empty():
+		if _overlaps(distance, float(world.loop_layout.start), float(world.loop_layout.start) + 70.0, 20.0):
+			return false
+	for offset in [-15.0, 0.0, 15.0]:
+		if world.in_gap(distance + offset):
+			return false
+	if not world.jump.is_empty() and world.jump.has("ramp_start") and world.jump.has("gap_end"):
+		if _overlaps(distance, float(world.jump.ramp_start), float(world.jump.gap_end), 22.0):
+			return false
+	if not world.action.is_empty():
+		for pad: Dictionary in world.action.get("pads", []):
+			if _overlaps(distance, float(pad.start), float(pad.end), 13.0):
+				return false
+		for gate: Dictionary in world.action.get("gates", []):
+			if absf(distance - float(gate.distance)) <= 18.0:
+				return false
+		for kicker: Dictionary in world.action.get("kickers", []):
+			if _overlaps(distance, float(kicker.start), float(kicker.take_off) + 10.0, 20.0):
+				return false
+		for dive: Dictionary in world.action.get("dives", []):
+			if _overlaps(distance, float(dive.start), float(dive.end), 22.0):
+				return false
+		for edge: Dictionary in world.action.get("edges", []):
+			if _overlaps(distance, float(edge.start), float(edge.end), 20.0):
+				return false
+	# A new pylon must be clear of a nearby return leg, not merely its own lane.
+	for side in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+		if world._near_road(world.position_at(distance, side * SAFETY_LATERAL_M), 7.1):
+			return false
+	return true
+
+
+static func planned_sites(world) -> Array[Dictionary]:
+	var result: Array[Dictionary] = []
+	var candidates: PackedFloat32Array = candidate_distances(world.length, world.low_detail)
+	for index in range(candidates.size()):
+		var distance: float = candidates[index]
+		if not is_safe_site(world, distance):
+			continue
+		var side: float = -1.0 if index % 2 == 0 else 1.0
+		var kind: String = ["beacon", "service", "signal", "sculpture"][index % 4]
+		result.append({"distance": distance, "side": side, "kind": kind})
+	return result
+
+
+static func build(world) -> void:
+	var built: Array[Dictionary] = planned_sites(world)
+	var before: int = world.decoration_count
+	var accent: Color = world.definition.accent
+	var trim: Color = accent.lightened(0.28)
+	var dark: Color = _dark_color(str(world.track_id))
+	for item: Dictionary in built:
+		var distance: float = float(item.distance)
+		var side: float = float(item.side)
+		var basis: Basis = world.frame(distance)
+		match str(item.kind):
+			"beacon":
+				_beacon(world, distance, side, basis, dark, accent, trim)
+			"service":
+				_service(world, distance, side, basis, dark, accent, trim)
+			"signal":
+				_gantry(world, distance, basis, dark, accent, trim)
+			"sculpture":
+				_sculpture(world, distance, side, basis, dark, accent, trim)
+	world.set_meta("kart_modular_parts", {
+		"revision": 1,
+		"track_id": str(world.track_id),
+		"low_detail": world.low_detail,
+		"sites": built,
+		"instance_count": world.decoration_count - before,
+		"minimum_lateral_m": SAFETY_LATERAL_M,
+		"colliders_added": 0
+	})
+
+
+static func _dark_color(track: String) -> Color:
+	match track:
+		"sonnenhafen": return Color("244965")
+		"zauberwald", "jungle_temple": return Color("28534c")
+		"candy_cloud": return Color("66517c")
+		"volcano_night": return Color("41303b")
+		"winter_sprint": return Color("44667e")
+		"desert_drift": return Color("6d513d")
+		"galaxy_ringway", "holo_city", "learning_lab": return Color("243856")
+		_: return Color("3d4669")
+
+
+static func _beacon(world, distance: float, side: float, basis: Basis,
+		dark: Color, accent: Color, trim: Color) -> void:
+	var up: Vector3 = basis.y
+	var at: Vector3 = world.position_at(distance, side * 9.1)
+	world._prop("cylinder", at + up * 0.09, Vector3(1.55, 0.18, 1.55), dark, basis)
+	world._prop("cylinder", at + up * 0.23, Vector3(1.28, 0.12, 1.28), trim, basis)
+	world._prop("cylinder", at + up * 1.9, Vector3(0.22, 3.28, 0.22), dark.lightened(0.12), basis)
+	world._prop("crystal", at + up * 3.93, Vector3(0.58, 1.28, 0.58), accent, basis, true)
+	world._prop("torus", at + up * 3.9, Vector3(1.28, 1.28, 1.28),
+		trim, basis * Basis(Vector3.RIGHT, PI * 0.5), true)
+	for direction in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+		world._prop("box", at + basis.x * direction * 0.28 + up * 1.75,
+			Vector3(0.10, 2.7, 0.10), accent.darkened(0.23), basis)
+	if not world.low_detail:
+		for level in range(3):
+			world._prop("box", at + up * (0.75 + level * 0.65) + basis.z * 0.19,
+				Vector3(0.32, 0.07, 0.06), trim, basis, true)
+
+
+static func _service(world, distance: float, side: float, basis: Basis,
+		dark: Color, accent: Color, trim: Color) -> void:
+	# Everything in this small service/display island is outside the safety rail.
+	var at: Vector3 = world.position_at(distance, side * 13.7)
+	var up: Vector3 = basis.y
+	world._prop("box", at + up * 0.18, Vector3(3.1, 0.38, 3.4), dark, basis)
+	world._prop("box", at + up * 0.42, Vector3(2.78, 0.10, 2.98), dark.lightened(0.18), basis)
+	for x in [-1.12, 1.12]:
+		world._prop("box", at + basis.x * x + up * 1.45 + basis.z * 0.94,
+			Vector3(0.16, 2.10, 0.18), dark, basis)
+	world._prop("box", at + basis.z * 0.94 + up * 2.5,
+		Vector3(2.72, 0.20, 0.18), trim, basis)
+	world._prop("box", at + up * 1.65,
+		Vector3(2.15, 1.40, 0.16), dark.darkened(0.35), basis)
+	world._prop("box", at + up * 1.65 + basis.z * 0.11,
+		Vector3(1.93, 1.18, 0.03), accent.darkened(0.38), basis, true)
+	for i in range(3):
+		world._prop("box", at + basis.x * (-0.58 + 0.58 * i) + up * (1.45 + i * 0.10) + basis.z * 0.15,
+			Vector3(0.39, 0.055 + i * 0.17, 0.04), trim, basis, true)
+	if not world.low_detail:
+		for i in range(4):
+			world._prop("cylinder", at + basis.x * (-1.03 + i * 0.68) + up * 0.58 - basis.z * 1.22,
+				Vector3(0.12, 0.20, 0.12), accent, basis, true)
+
+
+static func _gantry(world, distance: float, basis: Basis,
+		dark: Color, accent: Color, trim: Color) -> void:
+	var up: Vector3 = basis.y
+	var center: Vector3 = world.position_at(distance)
+	for side in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+		var at: Vector3 = world.position_at(distance, side * 8.5)
+		world._prop("box", at + up * 4.2, Vector3(0.42, 8.4, 0.56), dark, basis)
+		world._prop("box", at - basis.x * side * 0.31 + up * 4.85,

+extends SceneTree
+## Runtime regression for the reusable roadside modules and physical chassis aero set.
+## Run on the exact integrated Godot project, not on an isolated replacement scene.
+const WORLD = preload("res://scripts/games/kart_world.gd")
+const TRACKS = preload("res://scripts/games/kart_tracks.gd")
+const PARTS = preload("res://scripts/games/kart_modular_route_props.gd")
+const VEHICLE = preload("res://scripts/games/kart_vehicle.gd")
+const FLEET = preload("res://scripts/games/kart_fleet.gd")
+const AERO = preload("res://scripts/games/kart_modular_aero_kit.gd")
+
+func _initialize() -> void:
+	call_deferred("_run")
+
+
+func _check_world(id: String, light: bool) -> Dictionary:
+	var world = WORLD.new()
+	root.add_child(world)
+	world.build(light, id, true)
+	var record: Dictionary = world.get_meta("kart_modular_parts", {})
+	assert(not record.is_empty(), "Runtime did not call the modular prop builder")
+	assert(str(record.track_id) == id, "Wrong course metadata")
+	assert(int(record.revision) == 1)
+	assert(bool(record.low_detail) == light)
+	assert(int(record.colliders_added) == 0)
+	assert(float(record.minimum_lateral_m) >= 8.0)
+	var sites: Array = record.sites
+	assert(sites.size() > 0, "No real modular roadside pieces on " + id)
+	assert(int(record.instance_count) >= sites.size() * 5, "Instanced assembly is missing")
+	for entry: Dictionary in sites:
+		var d: float = float(entry.distance)
+		assert(d >= 32.0 and d <= world.length - 32.0)
+		assert(absf(float(entry.side)) == 1.0)
+		assert(str(entry.kind) in ["beacon", "service", "signal", "sculpture"])
+		assert(PARTS.is_safe_site(world, d), "A prop enters a reserved racing section")
+		for side in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+			var foot: Vector3 = world.position_at(d, side * PARTS.SAFETY_LATERAL_M)
+			assert(not world._near_road(foot, 7.1), "Scenery overlaps a return road")
+	var batches: int = 0
+	for child in world.get_children():
+		if child is MultiMeshInstance3D and str(child.name).begins_with("Decor_"):
+			batches += 1
+	assert(batches > 0, "Props did not enter the actual world MultiMesh renderer")
+	var result: Dictionary = {"track": id, "mode": "mobile" if light else "high",
+		"sites": sites.size(), "instances": int(record.instance_count), "draw_batches": batches}
+	world.free()
+	return result
+
+
+func _check_fleet() -> int:
+	assert(FLEET.ids().size() == 14, "Fleet catalog changed")
+	var total: int = 0
+	for style in ["comet", "glider", "terra", "phantom"]:
+		var kart = VEHICLE.new()
+		root.add_child(kart)
+		kart.configure("fox" if style == "comet" else "rabbit", Color("76bded"), style)
+		var body: Node3D = kart.get_node_or_null("AuroraCoachwork")
+		assert(body != null, "Original chassis root missing")
+		assert(int(body.get_meta("modular_aero_revision", 0)) == 1)
+		var parts: int = int(body.get_meta("modular_aero_count", 0))
+		assert(parts >= 20 and parts <= 28, "New chassis details absent or unbounded")
+		assert(kart.wheel_pivots.size() == 4, "Wheel anchors changed")
+		for anchor: Vector3 in AERO.envelope_anchors():
+			assert(absf(anchor.x) <= 0.7 and anchor.y < 0.9 and absf(anchor.z) <= 1.19,
+				"Additional aero hardware exceeds the original chassis envelope")
+		total += 1
+		kart.free()
+	return total
+
+
+func _run() -> void:
+	var report: Array[Dictionary] = []
+	for id in TRACKS.IDS:
+		report.append(_check_world(id, true))
+	report.append(_check_world("sonnenhafen", false))
+	report.append(_check_world("crystal_canyon", false))
+	var chassis: int = _check_fleet()
+	assert(report.size() == 14 and chassis == 4)
+	var path: String = "user://kart_modular_parts_report.json"
+	var output := FileAccess.open(path, FileAccess.WRITE)
+	assert(output != null)
+	output.store_string(JSON.stringify({
+		"schema": 1, "engine": Engine.get_version_info().string,
+		"routes_checked": report.size(), "chassis_checked": chassis,
+		"runtime_source": true, "android_frame_time_verified": false,
+		"results": report
+	}, "\t"))
+	output.close()
+	print("[KartModularParts] PASS: 12 mobile tracks + 2 high-detail scenes; four live chassis; no racing/LOD authority changed")
+	quit(0)
